To remedy this evil, Sixtus IV., on the 2nd August, 1483, decreed : — ( I ) That decisions on appeals given in Rome were to be held valid in Spain ; (2) that shamefaced penitents were to be absolved in secret ; (3) that those once absolved were not again to be molested by the Inquisitors.
